chapter: Cavalcade, Wynonie Harris and the 1953 show
title: Handover to Penny and Sides 5-6 header
summary: The interviewer steps out and asks about Swingers Inc. and Moby Dick's, then the Sides 5-6 header begins.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Penny, look, would you like to take this over for me for awhile now? I just want to make one or two phone calls, and what Eddie's going to talk about is after this, continued arranging through '50s and '60s, and playing with Swingers, Inc.
Swingers, Inc. You had a group called Swingers, Incorporated or something?
Well, anyway, you can see where we've got to.
Yeah, but I forgot now who it was.
Well, I thought maybe that was the name of the group you had on Long Island.
Could have been. I stayed in Moby Dick six years.
I stayed out in a place called Moby Dick's for six years.
